name.la: Sermones de vita et passione Domini
name.en-US: Sermons on the Life and Passion of Our Lord
name.pt-BR: Sermões sobre a vida e a paixão do Senhor

description.la: Triginta quinque sermones Thomae a Kempis de vita et passione Domini, ab adventu Domini usque ad Pentecosten: de desiderio prophetarum, de nativitate, de ieiunio, de passione et cruce, de resurrectione, ascensione et Spiritu sancto. Textus ex editione Pohl (1904), cum versione Anglica V. Scully (1907).
description.en-US: Thirty-five sermons on the life of Christ from Advent to Pentecost: the prophets' longing, Christmas and the Crib, the fast, the Passion and the Cross (the long meditation on seven points), Palm Sunday, Easter, the Ascension and the Holy Spirit. The Latin is Pohl's critical edition (Freiburg 1904), from a raw OCR of the printed volume; the English is Vincent Scully's 1907 translation (Kegan Paul), from the same text and following its sermons one for one.
description.pt-BR: Trinta e cinco sermões sobre a vida de Cristo, do Advento a Pentecostes: o desejo dos profetas, o Natal e o presépio, o jejum, a Paixão e a Cruz, o Domingo de Ramos, a Páscoa, a Ascensão e o Espírito Santo.

sources.edition: Thomae Hemerken a Kempis Sermones de vita et passione Domini, ed. M. J. Pohl (Freiburg: Herder 1904), Opera omnia III; archive.org raw OCR.
sources.description: The 35 sermons with Pohl's titles from his table of contents. Line numbers, running heads and page breaks stripped by script; Pohl's critical apparatus and introduction not imported. Raw OCR: drop capitals at sermon openings are often garbled and some slips remain after the scripted lexicon repair.

sources.edition: A Meditation on the Incarnation of Christ; Sermons on the Life and Passion of Our Lord; Of Hearing and Speaking Good Words, tr. Vincent Scully (London: Kegan Paul 1907); archive.org OCR.
sources.description: The 35 sermons with the titles of Scully's table of contents. Running heads and page numbers stripped by script and the margin scripture references that Scully prints beside the text removed where they interrupt a sentence; the translator's introduction and footnotes are not imported. Raw OCR: the first letter of each sermon (the drop capital) and some words may be lost.

title.la: 1. De desiderio prophetarum et devota praeparatione erga adventum Christi
title.en-US: 1. Of the desire of the Prophets and of devout preparation for the coming of Christ

title.la: 2. De occursu et susceptione caelestis Regis
title.en-US: 2. Of meeting and welcoming the Heavenly King

title.la: 3. In nativitate Christi. De festis animae
title.en-US: 3. On Christmas day. Of the feasts of the soul

title.la: 4. In nocte nativitatis Christi de quaerendo parvulo Iesu
title.en-US: 4. On Christmas night. Of seeking the Infant Jesus

title.la: 5. De devota visitatione nati pueri Iesu
title.en-US: 5. Of the devout visiting of the new-born Infant Jesus

title.la: 6. De mansione apud venerabile Christi praesepe
title.en-US: 6. Of abiding near the venerable Crib of Christ

title.la: 7. De gaudio huius diei et devoto obsequio Iesu
title.en-US: 7. Of the joy of this day, and the devout service of Jesus

title.la: 8. De desiderio videndi et osculandi Iesum
title.en-US: 8. Of the desire of seeing and embracing Jesus

title.la: 9. Ad beatam virginem, ut ostendat nobis Iesum filium suum
title.en-US: 9. To the Blessed Virgin, that she show us her Son, Jesus

title.la: 10. De perditione et inventione Iesu in templo
title.en-US: 10. Of the loss and finding of Jesus in the Temple

title.la: 11. De quatuor modis videndi Iesum secundum devotionis affectum
title.en-US: 11. Of four ways of seeing Jesus, according to the affection of devotion

title.la: 12. De sacra institutione ieiunii secundum formam Iesu Christi
title.en-US: 12. Of the sacred institution of the Fast, after the example of Jesus Christ

title.la: 13. De ferventiori emendatione nunc assumenda
title.en-US: 13. Of taking up now a more fervent amendment of life

title.la: 14. De ascensu Moysi in montem Sinai
title.en-US: 14. Of the going up of Moses into Mount Sinai

title.la: 15. De verbis Iesu et munditia cordis
title.en-US: 15. Of the words of Jesus, and cleanness of heart

title.la: 16. De amore Iesu et abnegatione sui
title.en-US: 16. Of the love of Jesus and self-denial

title.la: 17. De paupertate Iesu sectanda, et cura temporalium abicienda
title.en-US: 17. Of following the poverty of Jesus, and casting aside care for temporal things

title.la: 18. De fatigatione Iesu et salutari eius doctrina
title.en-US: 18. Of the weariness of Jesus and His saving doctrine

title.la: 19. De scriptura Iesu et misericordia eius in peccatricem
title.en-US: 19. Of the writing of Jesus and His mercy towards the sinful woman

title.la: 20. De custodia humilitatis ex consideratione propriae fragilitatis
title.en-US: 20. Of keeping humility from the consideration of our own weakness

title.la: 21. Dominica in passione. De planctu super passionem Domini
title.en-US: 21. Passion Sunday. Of lamenting over Our Lord's Passion

title.la: 22. De cruce Iesu, quam pro nobis ipse portavit
title.en-US: 22. Of the Cross of Jesus, which He bore for us

title.la: 23. De merito Dominicae passionis, et dignitate sanctae crucis
title.en-US: 23. Of the merit of the Lord's Passion, and the dignity of the Holy Cross

title.la: 24. De multiplici fructu ex recordatione Dominicae passionis, et de gratitudine eius
title.en-US: 24. Of the manifold fruit from remembrance of the Lord's Passion, and of thankfulness therefor

title.la: 25. De utili exercitio in Christi passione
title.en-US: 25. Of profitable exercise in the Passion of Christ

title.la: 26. De septem notabilibus punctis cogitandi de passione Christi
title.en-US: 26. Of seven notable points of meditation on the Passion of Christ

title.la: 27. In festo palmarum de processione Christi, et sex generibus hominum obsequentium Christo. Sermo primus
title.en-US: 27. On Palm Sunday. Of the procession of Christ, and of the six classes of men who honour Christ. First sermon

title.la: 28. De equitatu Christi non in curru Pharaonis sed in asello humilitatis. Sermo secundus
title.en-US: 28. Of the riding of Christ, not in Pharaoh's chariot, but on the ass of humility. Second sermon

title.la: 29. De resurrectione Christi, et spirituali consolatione animae
title.en-US: 29. Of the Resurrection of Christ, and the spiritual consolation of the soul

title.la: 30. De gaudio Dominicae resurrectionis
title.en-US: 30. Of the joy of the Lord's Resurrection

title.la: 31. De mystico paschae nomine, et novae vitae conversatione
title.en-US: 31. Of the mystic name of Easter, and of the conversation of the new life

title.la: 32. De ascensione Iesu in caelum
title.en-US: 32. Of the Ascension of Jesus into heaven

title.la: 33. In festo pentecostes, de donis Spiritus sancti
title.en-US: 33. On Pentecost: of the gifts of the Holy Spirit

title.la: 34. De consolatione Spiritus sancti
title.en-US: 34. Of the consolation of the Holy Spirit

title.la: 35. De sancta et unanimi conversatione primitivae ecclesiae in Hierosolymis
title.en-US: 35. Of the holy and united conversation of the primitive Church in Jerusalem
